name: Themesic Browser Agent Tools for WooCommerce
author: themesic

sections.description:
This plugin turns your site into a set of structured WebMCP tools that AI agents can discover and call, so an assistant can search your content and browse your catalog through a defined, permissioned interface instead of scraping pages.

It serves those tools two ways from one plugin:

  • In the browser for WebMCP-capable agents, via document.modelContext (with fallbacks).
  • Over REST + OpenAPI at /wp-json/themesic-agent/v1/manifest, /execute and /openapi – for any HTTP agent and for Custom GPT Actions, plus RFC 8288 Link discovery.

Every authorization decision is made server-side. The browser is never trusted.

What you get

WordPress content tools: get_site_info, get_menu, search, get_post, list_posts, list_categories, list_tags.

WooCommerce catalog tools (when WooCommerce is active): get_store_info, search_products, get_product, list_products, get_product_variations, check_product_stock, list_categories.

Plus the full engine: the in-browser WebMCP bridge, REST + OpenAPI + discovery, a security gate, per-caller and global rate limiting, an activity log with CSV export, and a request playground – all in the admin.

Every tool this plugin registers is a read tool. Nothing in it changes your content, your catalog or an order.

Security-first by design

  • Every tool is classified read or write. Reads of public content are public; writes always require a same-session nonce.
  • Four access tiers – public, browser session, logged in, and a specific capability – and an admin override that can only ever tighten a tool, never loosen it.
  • Per-tool and per-group enable/disable from the admin.
  • Per-caller and global rate limiting, applied before the authorization decision so rejected calls still cost the caller quota.
  • Output is sanitized before it reaches an agent (defense against stored XSS and prompt injection).
  • Denied calls are recorded in the activity log, not only successful ones, so an attempt is visible to you.
  • No administrator email, usernames, private meta, secrets, or non-public content are ever exposed. Password-protected posts are never returned.

Extensible

Register your own tools with a documented PHP API (themesic_agent_register_tools) – no core files need editing. Custom tools get the same security gate, validation, rate limiting and delivery surfaces as the built-in ones. Hooks are also provided for adding REST routes, resolving a caller’s identity, narrowing which tools are allowed, and extending the admin screens.

Privacy

This plugin makes no external calls at all. Every tool runs inside your WordPress install, nothing is sent anywhere on activation or afterwards, and the optional activity log stores recent tool calls with no personal data (and can be cleared or turned off). There is no account, no licence check and no telemetry.

A separate paid add-on exists

The author also sells a separate commercial plugin that adds write tools (cart, checkout, orders), a server-side MCP endpoint, per-agent API keys and integrations with other plugins. It is a different plugin, sold and distributed from the author’s own website.

It is not part of this package, in whole or in part. Its code is not here, switched off or otherwise; nothing in this plugin downloads, installs or checks for it; and nothing anyone can buy changes what the files in this package do. Everything described above works on its own and always will.
sections.installation:
1. Install via Plugins > Add New and search for the plugin name, or upload the ZIP under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate it. No build step, no Composer, no external setup required.
  3. Go to Themesic Agent Tools in the admin menu to review tools, settings, the usage dashboard, and the request playground.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4 or higher
  • PHP 8.1 or higher
  • WooCommerce (optional; only needed for the store tools)
sections.faq:
Do I need Chrome or a special browser?

No. The REST and OpenAPI endpoints work everywhere. The in-page WebMCP registration lights up automatically in browsers that support it; every other agent uses the REST API.

Is it secure?

Read tools for public content are public, in the same way WordPress’ own REST API is. Write tools require a same-session nonce, and tools that touch an account require a real login – a nonce alone is never treated as one. You control exactly which tools are exposed, denied attempts are logged, and rate limiting is applied before the permission check so failed guesses still cost the caller quota.

Does it require WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce tools appear only when WooCommerce is active; on a plain WordPress site they are hidden entirely.

Can an agent change anything on my site?

Not through this plugin. Every tool it registers reads public content. The engine supports write tools because custom and third-party tools can register them, and it holds those to a stricter standard – a same-session nonce, and a real login for anything touching an account.

Does it send my data anywhere?

No. This plugin contacts nothing. The tools run inside your WordPress install, there is no telemetry, no licence check and no call home – not on activation, not later. See the Privacy section.

Can developers add their own tools?

Yes, with a documented PHP API (themesic_agent_register_tools) – no core files need editing. Custom tools get the same security gate, validation, rate limiting, and all delivery surfaces.
sections.changelog:
0.1.3

  • This package now contains only the free plugin. The MCP endpoint, per-agent API keys, webhooks, the confirmation step and the write tools are not shipped here and are not switched off here – the code is absent, and the plugin reaches those features through hooks that nothing in this package answers.
  • No licensing code and no external requests. The plugin contacts nothing, on activation or afterwards.
  • CSV export of the activity log is part of this plugin.
  • Rate-limit counters no longer have a check-then-create step, so simultaneous requests cannot undercount.

0.1.2

  • Renamed. The plugin is now Themesic Browser Agent Tools for WooCommerce; the previous name was withdrawn at the WordPress.org review team’s request.

0.1.1

  • Abilities registered through the WordPress Abilities API now carry a permission callback, so they apply the same access checks as the REST endpoints.
  • Rate-limit counters are incremented atomically, so simultaneous requests can no longer slip past a limit.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: the WebMCP engine; in-browser bridge, REST, OpenAPI and discovery; security gate with rate limiting and output sanitization; admin UI with tools manager, settings, usage dashboard, logs and playground.
  • WordPress and WooCommerce read tools.
